items.description: todo-2 and todo-4 are coupled through src/index.ts. Both say 'make it available to consumers of the package', and src/index.ts is the only public surface — its header states consumers import from the package root and a lint rule blocks deep imports. Each todo must therefore append an export line to the same file, so two concurrent delegates would both rewrite it and the later write would drop the other's export.

todo-1 and todo-2 are coupled through the User interface even though their file sets are disjoint. todo-1 replaces the flat createdAt with a nested timestamps object; todo-2's PDF must print 'when the account was opened', which is that same field, and src/billing/invoice.ts already imports User. todo-2 written against the old shape stops compiling the moment todo-1 lands.

todo-2 and todo-4 are additionally coupled through src/billing/invoice.ts itself. The ledger todo-4's summarizeAccount must walk is module-private — `const ledger: Invoice[] = [];` at :10, never exported — so the helper has to be written into that same file, which is also where todo-2 adds the PDF renderer 'alongside the existing invoice code'. Two delegates therefore write invoice.ts as well as the barrel.
